## What

Short summary of the change.

## Why

Link to the Asana task + one sentence of context.

## How to test

Steps, or which tests cover it (e.g. `docker compose up` output, a workflow run link).

## Notes

Anything reviewers should look at first: new services/ports, changed env vars, follow-ups.

## Checklist

- [ ] `docker compose config` is valid and `docker compose up` works from a clean state (`down -v`)
- [ ] README updated (ports, env vars, commands)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data
